list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.
sources_note: Every guide below cites the official trophy description as published by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles) and Rockstar Games' official GTA VI material. Where a method is inferred from the official description rather than a published guide, the guide says so plainly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order (story, then activities, then collectibles, then the long grinds) and it pops last. Source: the official description itself, PlayStation via Exophase.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen objectives. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. Sources: the official description (PlayStation via Exophase) and Rockstar's GTA VI trailers, which open on Leonida's coast.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are unmissable story progress — play the main missions in order and this pops at the chapter's end. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. Source: the official description (PlayStation via Exophase).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. In GTA games that means finishing the story, all stranger missions, the counted activities and the collectibles this guide tracks — use this app's checklist as your completion list and clear every category. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. Source: the official description (PlayStation via Exophase).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the stunt total the game tracks. This is a long grind, so start early: stunt whenever you travel instead of driving straight, and the count builds up across the whole playthrough. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. Source: the official description (PlayStation via Exophase).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: the activities named across this list are the Shooting Range, Top Fun drone races, racing, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, bowling and the challenges. Sample one of each early — you do not need to win or finish them, just try them. Method inferred from the official descriptions; no third-party guide covers this yet. trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the Shooting Range, work through the challenges weapon by weapon, and replay any challenge until you hit its gold score. trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race — fly the course, win it, then move to the next location; the trophy pops when the last location is won. trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and each set completes when you hold all its cards. trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo/share feature: open it at landmarks, viewpoints and spots across Leonida and each new location counts once. This is a 100-location grind, so WAiNK everywhere you go from the start. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — the challenge list in the game shows them — so work through the easiest ones first and the count climbs as you play. trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: it needs your partner beside you, so do it while a partner is available in free roam, not after the story moves on. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car or nearby, then lose the cops and escape — the trophy pops when the heat is gone. trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: it needs your partner with you, so do it while a partner is available. Rob 3 shops one after another with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time — do not lose the cops or get busted between robberies, or the chain breaks and you start over. trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before it ends — a busy shootout or a wanted-level standoff is the place to try. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. Source: the official description (PlayStation via Exophase).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable: it is tied to one place, VCIA airport, and one specific act — leave the airport in a vehicle that is not a scheduled departure, such as taking a plane or vehicle out without going through the normal departure. Do it the first time you are at VCIA with a flyable vehicle handy. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. Get into a Rhino tank (they appear at high wanted levels and military spots) and survive the heat that follows; the trophy is about being in the tank, not a precise trick. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet. Source: the official description (PlayStation via Exophase).

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable per attempt: rob a jewelry store without being detected — if an alarm or a witness spots you, the attempt fails and you must try another store or another run. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Method inferred from the official description; no third-party guide covers this yet.
